instruction: Use both arms to grab the light brown wooden roller.

source.instruction: Use both arms to grab the light brown wooden roller.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the roller, which was at x = +3 (right half of the table); the RIGHT arm grasped the roller, which was at x = +3 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Point left gripper down, rotate yaw to -85 deg, and move right towards x=-6 above the roller's left end.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+24, -0, +0) cm, now 9 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the roller

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-6, -19, 94) opening 0.95; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper toward table (z=83.5) and adjust y. Orient right gripper to point down and rotate yaw -85 deg.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, -3, -10) cm, now 9 cm (horizontal) / +10 cm (vertical) from the roller; RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 28 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the roller

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-6, -22, 84) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (30, -19, 94) opening 0.95; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper left to x=11.5, y=-20.5 and lower to z=83.5 above the roller's right side.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-18, -1, -10) cm, now 9 cm (horizontal) / +10 cm (vertical) from the roller

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-6, -22, 84) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (12, -21, 84) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper to grasp height (z=77.5) around the roller.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+1, +0, -6) cm, now 9 cm (horizontal) / +3 cm (vertical) from the roller

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-6, -22, 78) opening 0.98; RIGHT fingertips (12, -21, 84) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right gripper to grasp height (z=78) and close both grippers to grasp the roller.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 9 cm (horizontal) / +3 cm (vertical) from the roller; closed the gripper (opening 0.27: holding the roller); RIGHT fingertips moved by (-1, +0, -6) cm, now 9 cm (horizontal) / +3 cm (vertical) from the roller; closed the gripper (opening 0.26: holding the roller)

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-6, -22, 78) opening 0.27; RIGHT fingertips (12, -20, 78) opening 0.26; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift the roller by moving left arm up to complete the grab instruction.
